reason: The user confirmed removing three items but did not provide replacement items or confirm the mechanism required by the tool: modify_pending_order_items requires new_item_ids matching each item_id in the same position, since only same-product option swaps are permitted, not outright removal of items. The candidate call passes item_ids of three items with an empty new_item_ids list, which is not a valid modification under the policy ('each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option') and previously errored with 'the number of items to be exchanged should match.' The assistant's own confirmation message also misrepresented the action as simply 'removing' items rather than performing valid same-product swaps, so explicit informed confirmation for a policy-compliant action was never obtained. Proceeding would call the tool with malformed/policy-violating arguments.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types
This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'... you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action
